errors.text: The proposed CALPHAD-plus-descriptor-ML workflow does not reconstruct the central MTP/FEP intervention or its replacement of EAM-based thermodynamic integration.
Evidence that Holder-mean descriptors predict room-temperature elastic moduli does not validate their use for melting temperature, entropy of fusion, or liquid-state heat capacity.
The claimed 5% melting-temperature and 10% entropy-of-fusion errors are unsupported by the cited evidence.
Heat-capacity prediction, explicitly requested in the problem, is not actually specified or validated.
The hypothesis omits key physical contributions identified by the target: electronic free energy, solid-state short-range order, and rapid FEP convergence from small MTP-to-DFT energy differences.
